name: pr-ivu-sales-and-use-tax
description: Compute Puerto Rico sales and use tax (IVU) for 2026. The state portion is 6 percent under section 4020.01 plus the 4.5 percent surtax under section 4210.01, which is 10.5 percent, and the municipal portion is 1 percent under section 6080.14, for 11.5 percent on a taxable sale of tangible personal property. Covers the food exemption, the 4 percent rate on services to other merchants and designated professional services, the USD 200,000 prior-year volume test, merchant registration, and the monthly return (Modelo SC 2915) on SURI, including the July 2026 municipal integration for the 73 participating municipalities. Trigger on "IVU", "Puerto Rico sales tax", "impuesto sobre ventas y uso", "SURI", "10.5 percent", "11.5 percent", "Modelo SC 2915", "municipal IVU".
